name: Wizard OS install snapshot 0.3.16
about: 0.3.15 plus three merged fixes: the Claude connection app is a default on every box as the new `claude-subscription` slot and, in alongside mode, is wired to the host agent's own Claude login (App Manager #110); the Agent Service detects a signed-out AI provider and names the app to reconnect in a `wizard_reconnect` field (Agent Service #60); the shell shows a 'Claude is signed out' panel with an Open/Get Claude button (Wizard UX #200). The App Manager image is unchanged.

modes.fresh: blank Ubuntu/Debian box: Runtipi + App Manager + the default app in every spot (including hermes-agent)
modes.alongside: box that already runs Hermes (run as its owner): App Manager + apps + the Wizard shell pointed at that Hermes; `wizard link` connects it, `wizard unlink` reverses it byte for byte

install.note: Alongside mode consumes the split image pins. Fresh mode still installs catalog defaults and reports image drift. No catalog release is changed by this snapshot.

wizard-app-manager.note: Merged main through #110; host-tooling changes only (claude-subscription default slot + alongside Claude login wiring) beyond 0.3.15.

wizard-agent-service.note: Official main with #60 (provider sign-out detection -> wizard_reconnect); public image published.

wizard-ux.note: Official main with #200 ('Claude is signed out' panel with Open/Get Claude button); public image published.

wizard-app-manager.note: Unchanged official multi-arch image from 0.3.12. Image build inputs are identical at the pinned host-tooling commit (git diff 904d987..e076a31 for image_inputs is empty).

shell.note: Alongside installs use the immutable official image above; index drift is informational.

ai-connection.note: Host Hermes owns and renews its sign-in; the connection app reads sanitized usage through the wizard-os dashboard plugin. Claude is installed by default as its own `claude-subscription` row below.

claude-subscription.note: Installed on every box next to ChatGPT. Alongside with host Hermes on a claude-subscription provider: App Manager binds the agent's own Claude Code login folder at the engine's /claude, so Connect/Test and auto-renew act on the agent's sign-in; tokens are never copied.
